subject: Briefing: executive demo — sponsor availability and backup coverage
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Goldstein <s.goldstein@novapower.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Briefing: executive demo — sponsor availability and backup coverage

Samantha,

Thanks for the productive discovery last week. Per our conversation, we'd like to lock a 45-minute executive briefing/demo next week so your CIO (David Liu) can see the end-to-end latency/cost tradeoffs and our proposed rollout approach. High-level agenda attached ("novapower-agenda-v2.pdf").

Windows we can offer:
- Tue Oct 1, 11:00–11:45 PT (preferred)
- Wed Oct 2, 10:30–11:15 PT

If David prefers a different time, happy to pivot — we want to make sure a sponsor-level attendee and a technical lead are present. Marcus will run the demo; Karthik will cover any infra/security questions.

Please confirm which window works and whether you want the session recorded (we can share a trimmed recording).

Thanks,
Irene

--
Irene Choi
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0189

Attachment: novapower-agenda-v2.pdf
From: Samantha Goldstein <s.goldstein@novapower.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: David Liu <d.liu@novapower.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Briefing: executive demo — sponsor availability and backup coverage

Hi Irene,

Thanks — David is available but prefers an earlier slot on Oct 1 if possible. He has an external board call late morning on Oct 2. Would you be able to start 30 minutes earlier on Oct 1 (10:30 PT)? If that doesn't work for Redwood leadership, we can do Oct 1 at 11:00 as your original note suggested.

Also looping David here — he generally likes a 30-minute walkthrough + 15 minutes for Q&A.

Samantha
VP Product, NovaPower
s.goldstein@novapower.com

Irene / Samantha —

I can definitely run the demo at 10:30 PT on Oct 1. 30 + 15 works for us. I'll focus the walkthrough on:
- Deployment architecture and latency profile for the 99th percentile
- Cost controls (batching, quantization profiles) we recommend for POC
- Rollout plan and fallback policies for uptime guarantees

If David wants live Qs, Karthik can speak to VPC/KMS and audit logs.

Samantha —

Great, thanks for the quick reply and for looping David in. Oct 1, 10:30–11:15 PT is now our target. Marcus will lead. Karthik, can you be on the call for the last 15 min to cover security & data residency? If so I'll send the calendar invite and include the updated slide deck ("tech-brief-CIO-slide-deck.pptx").

Samantha — one quick ask from procurement: they flagged a short data-retention/data-residency checklist for CIO review. I'll attach our short one-pager to the invite; if you want it sooner I can send it now.

If anything changes on your side, please let us know — otherwise we'll send the invite today.

Thanks,
Irene
